title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have a query. Please clarify. Alhamdulillah i am a software engineer. But since even after this i had to pay income-tax (Rs.9000/- apprx.) as my salary package is masha-Allah good. I wish to know that out of the interest money earned on the Fixed-deposit [when it matures in future] can i consume Rs.9000, since i had paid that as tax. Please reply. 2127 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 14701 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum, I had a factory which was closed down in 2001 because of sealing in delhi. Now the court has ordered me to pay compensation (on which they have charged interest) to the non muslim labourers who worked there.Since my financial position is not very good, I would like to ask whether i can pay this amount from the bank interest that has accumalated in my bank account or out of zakaat? Jazakallah Question: Assalamualaikum, I had a factory which was closed down in 2001 because of sealing in delhi. Now the court has ordered me to pay compensation (on which they have charged interest) to the non muslim labourers who worked there.Since my financial position is not very good, I would like to ask whether i can pay this amount from the bank interest that has accumalated in my bank account or out of zakaat? Jazakallah Answer ID: 14701 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1178/1178=M/1430) Interest amount of bank or Zakah cannot be given non-Muslim labourers in return to their work. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
